From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: SIG questionnaire (initial) + clarifying Qs

Thanks for the heads up — adding our notes below so Rafael can share concise answers with NovaCare: 

- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ with AEAD ciphers is our baseline. For customers requiring FIPS-validated endpoints we can support through dedicated Dedicated clusters and additional HSM integration (adds ~4-6 weeks for procurement + infra validation).
- Key management: Provider-managed KMS (cloud KMS with SOC 2 controls) is supported immediately. Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are available via our Private deployment or Dedicated with HSM integration; expected lead time 4-8 weeks depending on customer KMS onboarding.
- Data residency: For EU data we support region-restricted storage in our EU regions. Pseudonymization is an option but does not remove residency obligations; if they need EU-at-rest, we should plan for a EU-resident deployment.

I'll upload the SOC 2 cover and short KMS note to the shared Drive now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-novacare

Let me know if you want me to take point on the SIG responses; I can draft answers for the standard SIG sections and Rafael can review before we return to NovaCare.

-Marissa
